hands.why: 10 hp og 6 spar: spring til 3♠ er udgangsforslag i farven eller sans (mindst 5-farve, ca. 9–11 hp).

en.why: 10 HCP and 6 spades: the jump to 3♠ invites game in the suit or notrump (at least a five-card suit, about 9–11 HCP).
